name: Explicit Intersection Alpha Compositing
definition: Alpha compositing of 2D Gaussians using explicit intersection pairs (gaussian_id, pixel_id, image_id), allowing arbitrary intersection patterns and relying on automatic differentiation for the backward pass.
summary: Explicit Intersection Alpha Compositing aggregates overlapping Gaussian contributions via front-to-back compositing on pre-computed intersection pairs, distinguishing itself by handling arbitrary intersection patterns rather than fixed orders.
